$Comment: The spot the Great Turkey rises from (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey). It stands in the Turkey Graveyard's prefab as a marker entity beside the fight's own entity, so every fresh copy of the graveyard brings a fresh one. ManualTrigger means it never spawns the Great Turkey on its own: only the fight's script raises it, once the waves of Turkey Souls are down and players come near, and only while its last spawn is gone. RealtimeRespawn and RealtimeRespawnTime are the respawn form every marker must write; a marker that only fires on request never reads them. DeactivationDistance and DeactivationTime are wide so the Great Turkey is never packed back into the marker mid-fight.
